description: This file defines an abstract controller class for the OrangeHRM system, which manages HTTP responses, response handling, and enforces certain response types. It also uses traits for additional functionality, indicating it provides foundational behavior for other controller classes in the application.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: An abstract base class for controllers providing response management, including creation, retrieval, setting, and handling of responses, ensuring proper response types and status code handling.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the current response object, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object, validating the type to be Response, RedirectResponse, or null.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Prepares and returns a Response indicating a bad request by setting the appropriate HTTP status code.
